family: The two exact frozen bo1-q10-r10-c000000 physical CNFs d20-22 and d22-20, with h3969 hashes.
mechanism: Recover small physical branch exclusions from existing partial binary DRAT streams, without a solver restart.
first_output_gate: At least one independently checked new complete physical cube exclusion of width at most four spanning at least three fixed blocks/core atoms, with proof tied to the exact frozen CNF and measured relative to baseline unit propagation. If no such leverage is recovered, close and checkpoint failure.
candidate_rule: Complete addition records only; all literals physical variables 2..841; clause width <=4; no tautology or duplicates; touches >=3 atoms.
bounds: Scan exactly the two historical final streams once. No higher width, adjacent proof sources, new SAT solve, or larger solve cap in this gate.
trust: Raw DRAT records are untrusted candidates; RAT does not imply a physical clause. A claim requires an independently validated derivation or UNSAT proof for original CNF plus negated candidate.
forbidden_inferences: Partial streams are not UNSAT certificates
No full q10/h3887 task closure from a cube
No good43 or new Ramsey lower bound
